name: LM Studio
license: Free app (closed source), runs open models
summary: The easiest way to try free AI on your computer. Download one app, pick a model, start chatting.
gains: Shows which models fit your computer
tradeoffs: The app itself isn't open source (the models are)
Same quality limits as any local model
setupSteps: Open the Discover tab and search for the model the Local AI advisor recommends
Download it (LM Studio warns you if it is too big for your computer)
Go to the Chat tab, load the model and start chatting
commercialNote: Closed-source app. Check LM Studio's terms for workplace use; the models you run have their own licenses (see the Local AI page).
